title: 第一卷 第3章 打猎第一卷 第4章 玉娘我养你
content_zh:
想要打猎，得有趁手工具。
以现在的身体力量，赤手空拳，或者拿着短兵器是别想的，唯有拿着弓箭或者带着陷阱还有些机会。
李乘风走出木屋，往旁边空地上的小竹林看了看，又瞥向一边刚刚砍好的一棵劲竹，眼神顿时亮了亮。
陷阱暂时不好说，但是这弓箭……
“层压竹弓的威力足够用！”
李乘风回忆起前世制造弓箭的知识，忍不住拿起家里唯一的菜刀，立即动手将一棵刚刚砍掉的竹子拿来，开始动手制作层压竹弓。
造弓身，熬树胶，叠竹片，制作反曲，缠绕竹筋……
最后又砍掉一些三年老细竹，削成箭矢，摸了根结实的藤条绳拴好。
不多时的功夫，一把可堪一用的层压竹弓，并三十根竹箭就做好！
李乘风摸了摸在技能作用下已经不抖的腿肚子，心中满意。
前世的记忆果然有用！
他心中轻笑，随后看了看头顶的太阳。
估摸距离天黑还有五个小时左右的时间，当即把门一关，持弓背箭，带着家里的破菜刀和一个布袋子，直接奔着城外山里行去。
“…………”
清水县身为临着山水而建立的县城，出城之后仅仅三里，就到了最边缘的山林脚外。
几个人高马大，手持刀弓的汉子在山道入口处守着，见李乘风进山也不理睬，自顾自的待在那里。
但李乘风却知道，一旦他被山里面遍布的守林人看到在私人山林里动了手脚，这些人可就不会那么好说话了。
李乘风抿了抿嘴，权当看不到他们，径直沿着山路进山。
他沿着穿山而过的山脚山路走，走到山体一半的时候，撞见在山中巡逻的护林人，那人眼睛贼溜溜的盯着他，李乘风却面无表情的从中走过。
就这样，他一连从山脚穿了五座山，终于将外围的私人山林穿过，来到了无主的山林。

“咯咯~”
刚进山里没几步，忽然前方传来野鸡叫声。
“嗖！”
李乘风抬头看去，瞬间见到一只长着长尾羽的公野鸡，顿时眼睛一亮，迅速抬弓瞄准一射，箭矢猛然飞出。
箭矢飞出，擦着野鸡身体落在了山地里，野鸡也被惊飞。
李乘风抽了抽嘴角，反应过来这具身体不比自己穿越之前。
虽然有熊腰桩的力量在，让他的手比普通人的要稳，但也射的没穿越前那么准。
正要摇头轻叹，感慨还得多练的时候，下一刻眼前信息变化，他人愣了愣。
【技能：箭术】
【等级：未入门（110）】
“射箭也能形成技能！”
李乘风看着面板信息，心中一喜，眼睛大亮的在山林之中穿梭，见到猎物就射。
不多时，又消耗了九根竹箭。
【技能：箭术】
【等级：入门（120）】
【效果：稳定增加10%】
一股奇妙的信息涌入身心，李乘风瞬间觉得自己的手更稳了。
他看着眼前浮现的面板信息，眼神里流露出一抹神采，更加激动的往前走。
不过这一次，他开始寻找竹林，路上见到适合做成箭矢的直树枝、树苗，也会砍掉做成简易箭矢。
content_en:
If you want to hunt, you must have handy tools.
With the current physical strength, it is impossible to do it with bare hands or with short weapons. Only with bows and arrows or with traps are there some chances.
Li Chengfeng walked out of the wooden house, looked at the small bamboo forest in the open space next to it, and then glanced at a freshly cut bamboo tree on one side, his eyes suddenly brightened.
It’s hard to say what the trap is for now, but this bow and arrow...
"The laminated bamboo bow is powerful enough!"
Li Chengfeng recalled the knowledge of making bows and arrows in his previous life, and couldn't help but pick up the only kitchen knife in the house. He immediately took a freshly chopped bamboo tree and started making a laminated bamboo bow.
Making the bow body, boiling the gum, stacking bamboo sheets, making recurves, winding bamboo tendons...
Finally, he cut down some three-year-old thin bamboo, cut it into arrows, and tied it with a strong rattan rope.
In a short time, a functional laminated bamboo bow and thirty bamboo arrows were ready!
Li Chengfeng touched his calf, which had stopped shaking under the influence of the skill, and felt satisfied.
Memories from past lives really work!
He chuckled in his heart, and then looked at the sun above his head.
It was estimated that there were still about five hours before dark, so he immediately closed the door, held an arrow on his bow, took a broken kitchen knife from home and a cloth bag, and headed straight for the mountains outside the city.
"…………"
Qingshui County is a county town built next to mountains and rivers. Only three miles after leaving the city, we reached the foot of the mountain forest at the edge of the city.
Several tall men with swords and bows in hand were guarding the entrance to the mountain road. They ignored Li Chengfeng entering the mountain and stayed there minding their own business.
But Li Chengfeng knew that once he was seen tampering in the private forest by the forest guards all over the mountain, these people would not be so easy to talk to.
Li Chengfeng pursed his lips, pretending he couldn't see them, and went straight into the mountain along the mountain road.
He walked along the mountain road at the foot of the mountain. When he was halfway up the mountain, he bumped into a forest ranger patrolling the mountain. The man stared at him with furtive eyes, but Li Chengfeng walked past expressionlessly.
In this way, he passed through five mountains in a row from the foot of the mountain, and finally passed through the surrounding private forest and arrived at the ownerless forest.
"Giggle~"
Just a few steps into the mountain, suddenly the sound of pheasants was heard from ahead.
"Whoosh!"
Li Chengfeng looked up and instantly saw a male pheasant with long tail feathers. His eyes suddenly lit up, he quickly raised his bow and aimed a shot, and the arrow suddenly flew out.
The arrow flew out, grazed the pheasant's body and landed in the mountain. The pheasant was also frightened and flew away.
Li Chengfeng twitched the corner of his mouth and realized that this body was no better than before he traveled through time.
Although the power of the bear's waist stake made his hands steadier than ordinary people's, his shooting was not as accurate as before the time travel.
Just when he was about to shake his head and sigh, sighing that he still had to practice more, the information in front of him changed in the next moment, and others were stunned.
[Skill: Archery]
[Level: Not Beginner (110)]
"Archery can also form skills!"
Li Chengfeng looked at the information on the panel and felt happy. He walked through the mountains and forests with bright eyes and shot at the prey he saw.
Not long after, nine more bamboo arrows were consumed.
[Skill: Archery]
[Level: Entry (120)]
[Effect: Stable increase of 10%]
A strange information poured into his body and mind, and Li Chengfeng instantly felt that his hand was steadier.
He looked at the panel information that appeared in front of him, a look of excitement in his eyes, and he moved forward even more excitedly.
But this time, he started looking for bamboo forests. When he saw straight branches and saplings suitable for making arrows, he would cut them down to make simple arrows.
